step: Step 3B.2 — Final Independent Security and Migration Authorization Audit
verdict_justification: The proposed Alembic upgrade pipeline has been independently verified across both pending migrations (c742f9a1e0b5 and e4b19082a5c1). Standard Row Level Security coverage is verified across all eight public tables. Both migrations execute within a single atomic PostgreSQL transaction. Backend compatibility is confirmed via the postgres role's rolbypassrls=True and table ownership. However, PostgreSQL RLS does not protect against TRUNCATE, and existing table privileges retain arwdDxtm for anon and authenticated. Approval is conditioned on explicitly acknowledging this dual-migration execution, committing to a follow-up Step 3C privilege-hardening migration, and restricting post-execution verification to safe read-only operations.

pending_migrations.description: Enables standard Row Level Security on all eight public tables

truncate_security_finding.finding: PostgreSQL Row Level Security does not apply to TRUNCATE.
truncate_security_finding.technical_impact: Users with table-level TRUNCATE privilege can truncate tables even with RLS enabled. While PostgREST does not expose an HTTP TRUNCATE verb, internal database procedures or direct connections executing under anon or authenticated retain table-level truncate capabilities.
truncate_security_finding.remediation_status: Addressed via designed follow-up Step 3C privilege-hardening migration.

target_actions: REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.machines, public.sensor_readings, public.alembic_version, public.maintenance_history, public.alerts, public.tickets, public.ticket_proposals, public.consumed_tokens FROM anon, authenticated;
REVOKE ALL ON SEQUENCE public.sensor_readings_id_seq, public.maintenance_history_id_seq FROM anon, authenticated;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE postgres IN SCHEMA public REVOKE ALL ON TABLES FROM anon, authenticated;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE postgres IN SCHEMA public REVOKE ALL ON SEQUENCES FROM anon, authenticated;
proposed_step3c_hardening_design.downgrade_rule: Downgrade must NEVER blindly execute GRANT ALL TO anon, authenticated.

backend_compatibility_summary.query_execution_impact: Direct backend SQLAlchemy queries completely bypass standard RLS. Zero operational disruption.

alembic_transaction_verification.rollback_guarantee: Both c742f9a1e0b5 and e4b19082a5c1 execute inside a single PostgreSQL transaction block. Failure of either migration triggers a full rollback to revision 1273f18b72a2.

authorization_conditions: 1. Explicit human authorization for the dual-migration sequence (c742f9a1e0b5 then e4b19082a5c1) in a single atomic transaction.
2. Formal commitment to schedule Step 3C (least-privilege grant hardening) as an immediate follow-up migration to address TRUNCATE and default ACL privileges.

3. Mandatory restriction of post-execution verification to safe read-only operations (test_connection.py, verify_migration.py, catalog queries, anonymous PostgREST probes), strictly prohibiting mutating test suites against production.
